typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EBillPreferenceArchiveFilePath as string (),
	EBillPreferenceFilePath as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutFileName as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutPath as string (),
	FacetsDataSource as string (),
	FacetsPassword as string (),
	FacetsUserID as string (),
	TestVaraible as string (),
	varFilePath as string ()
}

source(output(
		EBILL_EFF_DT as string,
		MESSAGE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		EBILL_TERM_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT EPS.GRGR_ID,EPS.SBSB_ID,EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT,EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT , \'Overlapping Dates\' AS MESSAGE FROM AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS  JOIN  AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF EP ON EPS.GRGR_ID= EP.GRGR_ID AND EPS.SBSB_ID  = EP.SBSB_ID AND  to_date(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') > EP.EBILL_EFF_DT AND to_date(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') <=  EP.EBILL_TERM_DT  UNION   SELECT    EPS.GRGR_ID,    EPS.SBSB_ID,    EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT,    EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT,    \'Overlapping Dates\' AS MESSAGE  FROM    AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS     JOIN       AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF EP        ON EPS.GRGR_ID = EP.GRGR_ID        AND EPS.SBSB_ID = EP.SBSB_ID        AND  ((EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT = \'8888-08-08\'           OR EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT IS NULL           OR LENGTH(RTRIM(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT)) <= 8 ) AND to_date(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\') <= EP.EBILL_TERM_DT)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> EffDateOverlap
EffDateOverlap sink(input(
		EBILL_EFF_DT as string,
		MESSAGE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		EBILL_TERM_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EBILL_EFF_DT,
		MESSAGE,
		GRGR_ID,
		EBILL_TERM_DT,
		SBSB_ID)) ~> FlatFileDestination
